name: Coffee Traders

categories.label: Coffee Bars: deliveries
categories.labelVi: Quán cà phê: điểm giao hàng
categories.hint: VP printed below each of your Scoring markers on the Coffee Bars.

categories.label: Coffee Bars: column bonuses
categories.hint: Per column: 4 VP for most beans, 2 VP for second (tie: furthest down the banner).

categories.label: Milestones
categories.hint: VP on the milestone spaces where your markers sit.

categories.label: Cooperatives (QV ranking, 5 regions)
categories.labelVi: Hợp tác xã (xếp hạng QV, 5 vùng)
categories.hint: Per region rank by QV (plantation level; hospital 2, other buildings 1 only if you own a plantation there). 1st 16, 2nd 8, 3rd 4 (4-5 players only); ties: sum and divide, round up. Enter total.

categories.label: Arabica tracks
categories.hint: Count rows at/above each column; cumulative: 3 VP if all 6 rows >=2nd column, +7 if all 6 >=3rd, +6 per row >=6th, +4 per row at 7th.

categories.label: Work: donkeys/civets
categories.hint: 1 VP per donkey/civet in the Work section (not coins).

categories.label: Level-3 plantation from Row B
categories.hint: 4 VP if you built your level-3 plantation in Row B.

categories.label: Workers left in Worker Pool
categories.hint: 1 VP per worker in the Worker Pool.

categories.label: Trade & Build: constructed buildings
categories.hint: Sum of VP shown left of each (now empty) building space.

categories.label: Sell: fulfilled contracts
categories.hint: Sum of VP shown at the bottom of each fulfilled contract space.

categories.label: Counter track
categories.hint: VP for how high you filled your Counter track.

categories.label: Money (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Coins you own at the end.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, shared victory (best cup of coffee wins).

notes: family: area-majority. Cooperative regions: Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, Guatemala, Indonesia (Sumatra is not a cooperative). Cooperative VP entered as a single number because ties round up (rankAward has no round-up mode). 2-player game uses the Andre automa (separate rules PDF); Andre scoring not modelled. Arabica 7th column holds only one player per row.

sources.title: Coffee Traders rulebook v1.5 (Capstone Games)
sources.section: pp.25-27 End of Game (VP list, cooperative QV, Arabica track, tiebreaker)
